description: This Java class 'CatalogServiceHelper' provides static utility methods for filtering product attribute descriptions by language and for setting product availability based on locale, mainly used within a catalog management context of an e-commerce platform.

classes.name: CatalogServiceHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to assist with catalog product data handling, including filtering descriptions by language and customizing availability based on locale.

methods.name: setToLanguage
methods.description: Filters product attribute descriptions to only include those matching the specified language id and updates the product option and value descriptions accordingly.

methods.name: setToAvailability
methods.description: Modifies the product's availabilities to include only the default and locale-specific availability entries.
